verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript library whose whole API is used directly from JS (WebGLRenderer, scene and camera construction in the README). Community users call it a user-friendly abstraction and say it works with TypeScript, though some @types/three signatures don't match the code. The debugger part rests only on a threejs.org link to a three.js devtools Chrome extension, with no evidence of what it does. missing for 10: documented first-party debugging and inspection tooling, first-party TypeScript typings that match the code, and hands-on evidence of the debugging workflow.
